products.title: No Gi Closed Guard by Ffion Davies
products.body:
BJJ Phenom Ffion Davies Presents Her Complete No-Gi Closed Guard System, Designed To Outflank, Outmaneuver, and Overwhelm Opponents With Sophisticated Closed Guard Attacks!

  • Ffion is one of the most accomplished Jiu-Jitsu athletes of all-time! She is a multiple time IBJJF World Champion in both Gi and No-Gi, as well as an ADCC Champion!
  • Build your closed guard from the ground up with key details on maintenance, controlling posture, creating advantageous angles, and more!
  • Develop two distinct closed guard systems of attack from the overhook and shoulder crunch positions.
  • Overwhelm opponents from the overhook position with consistent entries, submissions sequences, omoplata offense, and counters to common defensive reactions.
  • Uncover unique options from the omoplata that allow you to adapt your attacks on the fly based off of your opponents reactions.
  • Discover the power of the shoulder crunch position, and its amazing versatility when used in the closed guard!
  • Learn powerful options from the shoulder crunch including sweeps, armbar options, Tarikoplatas, and MORE!

products.title: The Black Hole: No-Gi Closed Guard by Professor Henry Akins
products.body:
On this game changing series with Rickson Gracie black belt and legend, Henry Akins, he is going to show you the secrets to his highly effective and dangerous closed guard

  • Known for his hidden BJJ, Akins has long been famous for using subtle, simple and high level technical details to make techniques effective against anyone.
  • The closed guard is becoming increasingly less popular because people assume it doesn't work anymore, Akins is here to show you that this is simply not true. 
  • Henry has some of the most incredible never before seen details that will help you manipulate your opponents posture with ease, control their weight, adjust your angles and leverage your hip strength to sweep and submit your opponent
  • Many people assume the closed guard is not effective without the gi but Henry will QUICKLY change your perspective. Make the closed guard your best position and become DANGEROUS



Check Out a Free Sample:

What Will You Learn?

On this game changing series with Rickson Gracie black belt and legend, Henry Akins, he is going to show you the secrets to his highly effective and dangerous closed guard. Known for his hidden BJJ, Akins has long been famous for using subtle, simple and high level technical details to make techniques effective against anyone. The closed guard is becoming increasingly less popular because people assume it doesn't work anymore, Akins is here to show you that this is simply not true. 

Henry has some of the most incredible never before seen details that will help you manipulate your opponents posture with ease, control their weight, adjust your angles and leverage your hip strength to sweep and submit your opponent. Many people assume the closed guard is not effective without the gi but Henry will QUICKLY change your perspective. Make the closed guard your best position and become DANGEROUS.
